snippet.title: Five Nights at Freddy's: SHOWTIME Gameplay Demonstration
snippet.description:
A gameplay demonstration for my up and coming FNaF fangame.
It can be found on itch.io and GameJolt.com
I can't link anything at the moment, but you should be able to find the game just by going to either site and typing "Five Nights at Freddy's: Showtime" or "FNaF: Showtime".
